name: Bugbear Skinner

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description:
Leather armor is sturdier than cloth armor. It protects vital areas with multiple layers of boiled-leather plates, while covering the limbs with supple leather that provides a small amount of protection.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Leather armor grants +3 AC at levels 16-25, and +4 AC at levels 26-30.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Combat Advantage
traits.details: If a bugbear skinner hits a creature granting combat advantage to it with a melee attack, and that creature is not already taking ongoing damage, then the creature takes ongoing 5 damage (save ends).

powers.name: Mocking Rend
powers.usageDetails: when an enemy within line of sight becomes bloodied
powers.requirements: requires combat advantage against the target; requires a sickle

effect.description: The bugbear skinner makes two sickle attacks against the same target. If both attacks hit, the target takes ongoing 5 damage (save ends) and is dazed until the end of the bugbear skinner’s next turn

powers.name: Horrifying Mockery
powers.usageDetails: when an enemy within line of sight is bloodied

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.targets: targets one enemy in the burst

hit.description: the bugbear skinner pushes the target 1 square, and the bugbear skinner shifts 3 squares

powers.name: Bloodied Shift
powers.trigger: when the bugbear skinner is hit by an attack while bloodied

effect.description: A bugbear skinner deals 1d6 extra damage on the next attack it makes against a creature granting combat advantage to it. It must apply this bonus before the end of its next turn.
